entries.title: Epistola de Rasophoris seu raso indutis
entries.note: Greek 'EPISTOLH ... PROS TON OSIOTATON KATHGHTHN ... PATIKION MONASTHRION' at 114975-114987, Latin 'EPISTOLA DE RASOPHORIS SEU RASO INDUTIS' at 115004-115005; page 1359/1360. Ordo reads '1539' (garbled/transposed).

problems: The Elenchus prints NO columns in this volume (all entries body-only); columns come from the body, with the Ordo (which prints them, though badly garbled) as a cross-check.
The Ordo reads Dionysius's letter at 455 (body 453), Epistola de jejuniis 1533 (body 1333), Rasophoris 1539 (body 1359).

Epistola de jejuniis: the Greek/Latin title block appears twice in the OCR (lines 112895-112920 and 113187-113214, page numbers 1333/1334 then 1335/1336), and 'EPIST. DE JEJUNIIS' running heads recur at 114820 (col ~1357): either a second printing of the title or OCR page duplication. The first occurrence is recorded.
Not entered (omitted by the Elenchus, not a work): Index analyticus (line 116835, col 1381; the Ordo lists it).

Parts for the Epistolae canonicae and the Ecclesiasticae constitutiones are from the Ordo as read; several columns are garbled ('Bt', 'j', 'vil', '24', '9', '90') and unconfirmed in the body, as the brief directs. 'Interrogationes monachorum ... 931' is listed in the Ordo among the epistle commentaries; the Marci Interrogationes at 951 and Meditata at 1013 are separate Elenchus items.
Liber II of the Ecclesiasticae constitutiones reads '231' in the Ordo (likely 1231 with the leading digit lost).
